verses.en: Hearken, O ye people, and open your hearts and give ear from afar; and listen, you that call yourselves the people of the Lord, and hear the word of the Lord and his will concerning you.
verses.sm: Faalogo mai ia, outou le nuu e, ma tatala o outou loto ma ua’i mai o outou taliga mai mea mamao; ma faalogo mai, outou ua ta’ua outou lava o tagata o le Alii, ma faalogo mai i le afioga a le Alii ma lona finagalo e faatatau ia te outou.

verses.en: Yea, verily, I say, hear the word of him whose anger is kindled against the wicked and rebellious;
verses.sm: Ioe, e moni, Ou te fai atu, ia faalogo mai i le afioga a ia o lē o lona toasa ua sasao e faasaga i e e amioleaga ma e e fouvale;

verses.en: Who willeth to take even them whom he will take, and preserveth in life them whom he will preserve;
verses.sm: O lē ua finagalo e ave i latou lava o e ua finagalo o ia e ave, ma faasao i le olaga i latou o e ua finagalo o ia e faasaoina;

verses.en: Who buildeth up at his own will and pleasure; and destroyeth when he pleases, and is able to cast the soul down to hell.
verses.sm: O lē na te ati a’e e tusa ma lona lava loto ma lana filifiliga; ma faaumatia pe a finagalo i ai, ma mafai ona ia lafo le agaga i lalo i seoli.

verses.en: Behold, I, the Lord, utter my voice, and it shall be obeyed.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, Ou te tuu atu lo’u leo, ma ia usiusita’ia.

verses.en: Wherefore, verily I say, let the wicked take heed, and let the rebellious fear and tremble; and let the unbelieving hold their lips, for the day of wrath shall come upon them as a whirlwind, and all flesh shall know that I am God.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e moni Ou te fai atu, ia tuu atu i e e amioleaga ia faaeteete, ma tuu atu i e e amioleaga ia matata’u ma gatete; ma tuu atu i e e lē talitonu ia taofi o latou laugutu, ona o le a oo mai i o latou luga le aso o le toasa e pei o se asiosio, ma o le a iloa e tagata uma o A’u o le Atua.

verses.en: And he that seeketh signs shall see signs, but not unto salvation.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e sailia faailoga o le a vaai i faailoga, ae lē mo le olataga.

verses.en: Verily, I say unto you, there are those among you who seek signs, and there have been such even from the beginning;
verses.sm: E moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e i ai ni isi o i latou o loo i totonu o outou o e ua saili i faailoga, ma sa i ai lava ni isi faapena mai le amataga;

verses.en: But, behold, faith cometh not by signs, but signs follow those that believe.
verses.sm: Peitai, faauta, e lē oo mai le faatuatua e ala i faailoga, ae o faailoga e mulimuli ia te i latou o e e talitonu.

verses.en: Yea, signs come by faith, not by the will of men, nor as they please, but by the will of God.
verses.sm: Ioe, e oo mai faailoga e ala i le faatuatua, ae lē ala mai i le manao o tagata, pe ona ua loto i ai, ae e ala mai i le finagalo o le Atua.

verses.en: Yea, signs come by faith, unto mighty works, for without faith no man pleaseth God; and with whom God is angry he is not well pleased; wherefore, unto such he showeth no signs, only in wrath unto their condemnation.
verses.sm: Ioe, e oo mai faailoga i le faatuatua, i galuega ofoofogia, aua a aunoa ma le faatuatua, e leai se tagata e fiafia i ai le Atua; ma o lē ua toatamai i ai le Atua ua lē fiafia i ai o ia; o le mea lea, e leai ni faailoga e faaalia e ia i e faapea, na’o le toasa e oo i lo latou ta’usalaga.

verses.en: Wherefore, I, the Lord, am not pleased with those among you who have sought after signs and wonders for faith, and not for the good of men unto my glory.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o A’u, o le Alii, ua Ou lē fiafia ia i latou o i totonu o outou ua saili i faailoga ma mea ofoofogia mo le faatuatua, a ua lē mo le lelei o tagata ma lo’u mamalu.

verses.en: Nevertheless, I give commandments, and many have turned away from my commandments and have not kept them.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, Ou te tuu atu poloaiga, ma e toatele ua liliuese mai a’u poloaiga ma ua latou lē tausia i latou.

verses.en: There were among you adulterers and adulteresses; some of whom have turned away from you, and others remain with you that hereafter shall be revealed.
verses.sm: Sa i ai i totonu o outou alii mulilulua ma fafine mulilulua; o ni isi o i latou ua liliuese mai ia te outou, ma o isi o loo nonofo pea faatasi ma outou ma o le a faaalia i se taimi mulimuli mai.

verses.en: Let such beware and repent speedily, lest judgment shall come upon them as a snare, and their folly shall be made manifest, and their works shall follow them in the eyes of the people.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i e faapea ia faaeteete ma salamo vave, ne’i oo mai le faamasinoga i luga o i latou e pei o se mailei, ma o lo latou valea o le a faaalia, ma o a latou galuega o le a mulimuli atu ia te i latou i le vaaiga a tagata.

w.en: in the sight of the people,

verses.en: And verily I say unto you, as I have said before, he that looketh on a woman to lust after her, or if any shall commit adultery in their hearts, they shall not have the Spirit, but shall deny the faith and shall fear.
verses.sm: Ma e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e pei ona Ou fai atu muamua, o ia o lē e vaai atu i se fafine ma manao i ai, pe afai e mulilulua ni isi i o latou loto, o le a latou lē maua le Agaga, ae o le a latou faafitia le faatuatuaga ma o le a matata’u.

verses.en: Wherefore, I, the Lord, have said that the fearful, and the unbelieving, and all liars, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie, and the whoremonger, and the sorcerer, shall have their part in that lake which burneth with fire and brimstone, which is the second death.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o A’u, o le Alii, ua faapea atu o e e matata’u, ma e e lē talitonu, ma tagata pepelo uma, ma o soo se tasi e fiafia i le pepelo ma faia se pepelo, ma le faitaaga ma le faataulaitu, o le a i ai lo latou taui i lena lepa ua mu i le afi ma le teiō, o le oti faalua lea.

verses.en: Verily I say, that they shall not have part in the first resurrection.
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu, o le a latou le i ai i le uluai toetutu.

verses.en: And now behold, I, the Lord, say unto you that ye are not justified, because these things are among you.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, e fai atu ia te outou ua lē ta’uamiotonuina outou, ona ua i ai nei mea i totonu o outou.

verses.en: Nevertheless, he that endureth in faith and doeth my will, the same shall overcome, and shall receive an inheritance upon the earth when the day of transfiguration shall come;
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, o ia o lē e tumau i le faatuatua ma faia lo’u loto, o ia lava lea o le a manumalo, ma o le a maua e ia se tofi i le lalolagi pe a oo mai le aso o le liua;

verses.en: When the earth shall be transfigured, even according to the pattern which was shown unto mine apostles upon the mount; of which account the fulness ye have not yet received.
verses.sm: Pe a liua le lalolagi, e tusa ai ma le mamanu sa faaali atu i a’u aposetolo i luga o le mauga; o le tala o lea mea tou te lei maua le atoatoa.

verses.en: And now, verily I say unto you, that as I said that I would make known my will unto you, behold I will make it known unto you, not by the way of commandment, for there are many who observe not to keep my commandments.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e pei ona sa Ou fai atu o le a Ou faailoa atu lo’u loto ia te outou, faauta o le a Ou faailoa atu ia te outou, e lē ala atu o se poloaiga, ona o loo i ai le toatele o e ua lē tausisi e tausi i a’u poloaiga.

verses.en: But unto him that keepeth my commandments I will give the mysteries of my kingdom, and the same shall be in him a well of living water, springing up unto everlasting life.
verses.sm: Ae ia te ia o lē ua tausi i a’u poloaiga o le a Ou tuu atu i ai mealilo o lo’u malo, ma o ia lava lea o le a i ai ia te ia se puna o le vai ola, e puna a’e i le ola faavavau-tumau.

verses.en: And now, behold, this is the will of the Lord your God concerning his saints, that they should assemble themselves together unto the land of Zion, not in haste, lest there should be confusion, which bringeth pestilence.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, o le finagalo lenei o le Alii lo outou Atua e faatatau i lana au paia, e tatau ona latou faapotopoto faatasi i latou lava i le laueleele o Siona, e lē faanatinatia, ne’i i ai se fenumiai, e oo mai ai puapuaga.

verses.en: Behold, the land of Zion—I, the Lord, hold it in mine own hands;
verses.sm: Faauta, o le laueleele o Siona—o A’u, o le Alii, ua Ou umia i o’u lava lima;

verses.en: Nevertheless, I, the Lord, render unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsar's.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, o A’u, o le Alii, Ou te tuu atu ia Kaisara mea e a Kaisara.

verses.en: Wherefore, I the Lord will that you should purchase the lands, that you may have advantage of the world, that you may have claim on the world, that they may not be stirred up unto anger.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o A’u o le Alii Ou te loto ia outou faatau mai laueleele, ina ia mafai ona outou maua tulaga sili atu i le lalolagi, ina ia mafai ona outou maua āiā i le lalolagi, ina ia lē mafai ona faaoso a’e i latou i le ita.

verses.en: For Satan putteth it into their hearts to anger against you, and to the shedding of blood.
verses.sm: Aua ua tuu e Satani i totonu o o latou loto ia feitai faasaga mai ia te outou, ma i le faamaligiina o le toto.

verses.en: Wherefore, the land of Zion shall not be obtained but by purchase or by blood, otherwise there is none inheritance for you.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o le a lē maua le laueleele o Siona vagana ai i le faatau mai po o i le toto, a lē o lea, e leai se tofi mo outou.

verses.en: And if by purchase, behold you are blessed;
verses.sm: Ma afai e maua e ala i le faatau mai, faauta ua outou manuia;

verses.en: And if by blood, as you are forbidden to shed blood, lo, your enemies are upon you, and ye shall be scourged from city to city, and from synagogue to synagogue, and but few shall stand to receive an inheritance.
verses.sm: Ma afai e maua e ala i le toto, talu ai ona ua faasaina outou e faamasaa le toto, faauta, ua i o outou luga o outou fili, ma o le a sauaina outou mai lea aai i lea aai, ma mai lea sunako i lea sunako, ma e toaitiiti o le a tutulai mai e maua se tofi.

verses.en: I, the Lord, am angry with the wicked; I am holding my Spirit from the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.sm: O A’u, o le Alii, ua Ou ita i e amioleaga; ua Ou taofia lo’u Agaga mai tagata o le lalolagi.

verses.en: I have sworn in my wrath, and decreed wars upon the face of the earth, and the wicked shall slay the wicked, and fear shall come upon every man;
verses.sm: Ua Ou tauto i lo’u ita, ma folafola taua i luga o le fogaeleele, ma o e amioleaga o le a fasiotia e amioleaga, ma o le a oo mai le mata’u i luga o tagata uma;

w.en: upon the face of the earth,

verses.en: And the saints also shall hardly escape; nevertheless, I, the Lord, am with them, and will come down in heaven from the presence of my Father and consume the wicked with unquenchable fire.
verses.sm: Ma o le au paia foi o le a toeitiiti lē sao ai; ae ui i lea, o A’u, o le Alii, o i le lagi, ua faatasi ma i latou, ma o le a Ou alu ifo mai luma o lo’u Tamā i le lagi ma faaumatia e amioleaga i le afi e lē matineia.

verses.en: And behold, this is not yet, but by and by.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, e le’i oo mai lenei mea, ae ua lata mai lava.

verses.en: Wherefore, seeing that I, the Lord, have decreed all these things upon the face of the earth, I will that my saints should be assembled upon the land of Zion;
verses.sm: O le mea lea, talu ai ona o A’u, o le Alii, na folafolaina atu nei mea uma i luga o le fogaeleele, Ou te loto ia faapotopoto la’u au paia i luga o le laueleele o Siona;

w.en: upon the face of the earth,

verses.en: And that every man should take righteousness in his hands and faithfulness upon his loins, and lift a warning voice unto the inhabitants of the earth; and declare both by word and by flight that desolation shall come upon the wicked.
verses.sm: Ma e tatau i tagata uma ona ave le amiotonu i ona lima ma le faamaoni i ona sulugatiti, ma siitia a’e se leo o le lapataiga i tagata o le lalolagi; ma ta’u atu e ala i le upu ma le solaese, o le a oo mai le faafanoga i luga o e amioleaga.

verses.en: Wherefore, let my disciples in Kirtland arrange their temporal concerns, who dwell upon this farm.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia tuu atu i o’u soo i Katelani, o e o nonofo i luga o lenei faatoaga, ia faatulaga o latou atugaluga faaletino.

verses.en: Let my servant Titus Billings, who has the care thereof, dispose of the land, that he may be prepared in the coming spring to take his journey up unto the land of Zion, with those that dwell upon the face thereof, excepting those whom I shall reserve unto myself, that shall not go until I shall command them.
verses.sm: Ia tuu i la’u auauna o Tito Billings, o lē ua i ai lona tausiga o le faatoaga, e faatea atu le laueleele, ina ia mafai ona saunia o ia i le tautotogo a sau, e alu a’e lana malaga i le laueleele o Siona, faatasi ma i latou o e o nonofo ai, vagana ai i latou o e o le a Ou faapolopoloina mo a’u lava, o e o le a lē o atu seia Ou poloaiina ai i latou.

verses.en: And let all the moneys which can be spared, it mattereth not unto me whether it be little or much, be sent up unto the land of Zion, unto them whom I have appointed to receive.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu tupe uma e mafai ona faasaoina, e lē afaina ia te a’u pe itiiti pe tele, e auina atu i le laueleele o Siona, ia i latou o e ua Ou tofia e mauaina.

verses.en: Behold, I, the Lord, will give unto my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., power that he shall be enabled to discern by the Spirit those who shall go up unto the land of Zion, and those of my disciples who shall tarry.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, o le a Ou tuu atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, le mana o le a mafai ai e ia ona iloatino e ala i le Agaga, i latou o e e o a’e i le laueleele o Siona, ma i latou o o’u soo o e o le a nonofo pea.

verses.en: Let my servant Newel K. Whitney retain his store, or in other words, the store, yet for a little season.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Newel K. Whitney e faatumauina pea lona faleoloa, pe i se isi faaupuga, le faleoloa, mo se vaitau itiiti.

verses.en: Nevertheless, let him impart all the money which he can impart, to be sent up unto the land of Zion.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, ia tuu atu ia te ia e faamatuu atu tupe uma e mafai ona ia faamatuu atu, e auina atu i i le laueleele o Siona.

verses.en: Behold, these things are in his own hands, let him do according to wisdom.
verses.sm: Faauta, o nei mea ua i ai i ona lava lima, ia tuu atu ia te ia e fai e tusa ai ma le faautauta.

verses.en: Verily I say, let him be ordained as an agent unto the disciples that shall tarry, and let him be ordained unto this power;
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu, ia faauuina o ia o se sui mo soo o le a nonofo pea, ma ia faauuina o ia i lenei mana;

verses.en: And now speedily visit the churches, expounding these things unto them, with my servant Oliver Cowdery. Behold, this is my will, obtaining moneys even as I have directed.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, asiasi vave atu i aulotu, faatasi ma la’u auauna o Oliva Kaotui, ma faamalamalama atu nei mea ia te i latou. Faauta, o lo’u loto lea, i le mauaina mai o tupe e pei lava ona sa Ou faatonuina.

verses.en: He that is faithful and endureth shall overcome the world.
verses.sm: O ia o lē e faamaoni ma tumau o le a manumalo i le lalolagi.

verses.en: He that sendeth up treasures unto the land of Zion shall receive an inheritance in this world, and his works shall follow him, and also a reward in the world to come.
verses.sm: O ia o lē na te auina atu oa i luga i le laueleele o Siona o le a maua e ia se tofi i le lalolagi lenei, ma se taui foi i le lalolagi a sau, ma o le a mulimuli atu ana galuega ia te ia.

verses.en: Yea, and blessed are the dead that die in the Lord, from henceforth, when the Lord shall come, and old things shall pass away, and all things become new, they shall rise from the dead and shall not die after, and shall receive an inheritance before the Lord, in the holy city.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma amuia lava e e oti o e e oti i le Alii, mai le taimi nei ma le agai i luma, pe a afio mai le Alii, ma o le a mavae atu ai mea tuai, ma faafouina ai mea uma, o le a latou tutulai mai nai le oti ma o le a lē feoti pe a mavae, ma o le a latou maua se tofi i luma o le Alii, i le aai paia.

verses.en: And he that liveth when the Lord shall come, and hath kept the faith, blessed is he; nevertheless, it is appointed to him to die at the age of man.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e ola pe a afio mai le Alii, ma sa ia tausia le faatuatuaga, amuia lava o ia; ae ui i lea, ua tofia ia te ia ia oti i tausaga o le tagata.

verses.en: Wherefore, children shall grow up until they become old; old men shall die; but they shall not sleep in the dust, but they shall be changed in the twinkling of an eye.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o le a tutupu a’e fanau seia oo ina latou matutua, o le a feoti toeaiina matutua; ae o le a lē momoe i latou i le efuefu, ae o le a liua i latou i le emo o le mata.

verses.en: Wherefore, for this cause preached the apostles unto the world the resurrection of the dead.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o le pogai lenei na talai atu ai e le au aposetolo i le lalolagi le toetutu mai o e ua oti.

verses.en: These things are the things that ye must look for; and, speaking after the manner of the Lord, they are now nigh at hand, and in a time to come, even in the day of the coming of the Son of Man.
verses.sm: O nei mea o mea ia e ao ina outou tulimatai atu i ai; ma, i le tautala atu e tusa ma le ala a le Alii, ua lata mai lava ona oo mai ia mea, ma i se taimi a sau, i le aso lava lea o le afio mai o le Atalii o le Tagata.

verses.en: And until that hour there will be foolish virgins among the wise; and at that hour cometh an entire separation of the righteous and the wicked; and in that day will I send mine angels to pluck out the wicked and cast them into unquenchable fire.
verses.sm: Ma seia oo i lena itula, o le a i ai taupou valelea i totonu o e popoto; ma i le itula lena e oo mai ai se tuueseesega atoa o e amiotonu ma e amioleaga; ma i le aso lena o le a ’Ou auina atu ai a’u agelu e ’oto ese e amioleaga ma lafo i latou i le afi e lē matineia.

w.en: and cast them into the fire,

verses.en: And now behold, verily I say unto you, I, the Lord, am not pleased with my servant Sidney Rigdon; he exalted himself in his heart, and received not counsel, but grieved the Spirit;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o A’u, o le Alii, ua Ou lē fiafia i la’u auauna o Sini Rikitone; ua faaea e ia o ia lava i lona loto, ma sa lē talia e ia le fautuaga, ae ua faatausuai i le Agaga;

verses.en: Wherefore his writing is not acceptable unto the Lord, and he shall make another; and if the Lord receive it not, behold he standeth no longer in the office to which I have appointed him.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua lē talia ai ana tusitusiga i le Alii, ma ia faia e ia se isi tusitusiga; ma afai e lē taliaina e le Alii, faauta e lē toe tu o ia i le tofiga na Ou tofia i ai o ia.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, those who desire in their hearts, in meekness, to warn sinners to repentance, let them be ordained unto this power.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o i latou o e ua mananao i o latou loto, i le agamalu, e lapatai atu i e ua agasala ia salamo, ia tuu atu i latou ia faauuina i lenei mana.

verses.en: For this is a day of warning, and not a day of many words. For I, the Lord, am not to be mocked in the last days.
verses.sm: Aua o se aso lenei o le lapataiga, ae lē o se aso mo le tele o upu. Aua o A’u, o le Alii, ia lē ulagia i aso gataaga.

verses.en: Behold, I am from above, and my power lieth beneath. I am over all, and in all, and through all, and search all things, and the day cometh that all things shall be subject unto me.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua Ou sau mai lugā, ma ua taoto i lalo ifo lo’u mana. Ou te pule i mea uma, ma ua i ai i totonu o mea uma, ma e ala atu i mea uma, ma vailiili i mea uma, ma e oo mai le aso o le a i ai mea uma i la’u pule.

verses.en: Behold, I am Alpha and Omega, even Jesus Christ.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u o le Alefa ma le Omeka, o Iesu Keriso lava.

verses.en: Wherefore, let all men beware how they take my name in their lips—
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia tuu atu i tagata uma ia faaeteete i le ala latou te faaaoga ai lo’u igoa i o latou laugutu—

verses.en: For behold, verily I say, that many there be who are under this condemnation, who use the name of the Lord, and use it in vain, having not authority.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu, e toatele e ua i ai i lalo o lenei tausalaga, o e ua latou faaaoga le suafa o le Alii, ma faaaogaina fua, e aunoa ma le pule.

verses.en: Wherefore, let the church repent of their sins, and I, the Lord, will own them; otherwise they shall be cut off.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia tuu atu i le ekalesia ia salamo i a latou agasala, ma o A’u, o le Alii, o le a fai i latou mo A’u; a lē o lea o le a vavae ese i latou.

verses.en: Remember that that which cometh from above is sacred, and must be spoken with care, and by constraint of the Spirit; and in this there is no condemnation, and ye receive the Spirit through prayer; wherefore, without this there remaineth condemnation.
verses.sm: Ia manatua o le mea e sau mai luga ua paia, ma e ao ona tautalagia ma le faaeteete, ma i le taofiofiga a le Agaga; ma ua leai se tausalaga i lenei mea, ma e tou te maua le Agaga e ala i le tatalo; o le mea lea, a aunoa ma lenei, e tumau pea le tausalaga.

verses.en: Let my servants, Joseph Smith, Jun., and Sidney Rigdon, seek them a home, as they are taught through prayer by the Spirit.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i a’u auauna, o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma Sini Rikitone, e saili mo se fale mo i laua, e pei ona aoaoina ai i laua e le Agaga e ala i le tatalo.

verses.en: These things remain to overcome through patience, that such may receive a more exceeding and eternal weight of glory, otherwise, a greater condemnation. Amen.
verses.sm: O nei mea ua tumau pea e faatoilaloina ai e ala i le onosai, ina ia mafai ona maua e e faapena se fuataga matuā tele atu ma faavavau o le mamalu, a lē o lea, o se tausalaga tele atu. Amene.
